Query: I'm organizing my archival findings. Please create new phone contacts for the individuals listed in the third, fourth, and sixth documents here, making sure to include their addresses and phone numbers where available.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create new contacts for the people listed in the third, fourth, and sixth images, including their addresses and phone numbers. If the assistant asks for clarification on which documents, point out that you mean the test order form, the graduate application, and the invoice. Do not provide the actual names or details yourself. Once the assistant confirms the contacts are created, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2
Query: Now, create a new note titled 'Historical Organizations' and write down the names and addresses of the organizations found on the first and fifth pages.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to create a note titled 'Historical Organizations' that includes the names and addresses of the organizations from the first and fifth images (the script title page and the Federal Register page). If the assistant misses any details or asks which ones, guide it back to those specific images. Wait for confirmation that the note has been saved before moving on.

ROUND 3
Query: Finally, send an email to my co-researcher at historian@example.com with the subject 'Aspen 69 Checked Names'. In the body, list all the names from the second document that have a handwritten checkmark next to them, and then append the full text of my 'Historical' note.
Instructions: Tell the assistant to send an email to historian@example.com with the subject 'Aspen 69 Checked Names'. Explain that the email body should list the names from the second image (the Aspen reservations list) that have a checkmark next to them, followed by the text of your 'Historical' note. Because there is a preexisting note called 'Historical Landmarks' on the device, the assistant should ask you to clarify which note you mean. When it does, specify that you want the 'Historical Organizations' note you just created. Once the email is sent, end the conversation.
